title: Convolution powers of a probability density
statement: For a probability density $\varphi$ on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, define its zeroth convolution power to be the subset density of the singleton containing $0$. Recursively, its $(d+1)$st convolution power is the convolution of its $d$th power with $\varphi$.
